parsed.lead:
Gold is the standard currency in the game.

Gold is used to upgrade and rank up Bots and Mods, to start Away Missions, to start Arena fights, to start Alliance Missions (formerly), and to upgrade Masteries.

Gold can be earned by completing fights and in all game modes, from successfully completing Away Missions, helping other Commanders in an Alliance with help requests, from some Alliance Quests, from certain crystals like the Arena Crystal and the Gold Crystal, Daily Deals, duplicate Bots and Mods, and Forging.

as_of_2023.raw_wikitext:
[[File:Energon.png|thumb|right]]
'''Energon''' is the premium currency typical of a freemium mobile game with microtransactions.

== Where to Spend ==
Energon can be spent on, among other things:
* All items in the store other than those in the Raid store.
* Premium Bot [[Crystal]]s, Premium Mod Crystals, Gold Crystals, and Featured Bot Crystals
* Refreshing selection of Away Missions (5)
* Selecting another opponent in [[Raid]]s (2, 6, 10, 14)
* replenishing a Raid Ticket (10)
* Changing opponents in [[Arena]]s (5)
* Cooldown of Bots in Arenas (5, 10, 15, 30)
* Limited-time 24-hour flash offers, ranging from 100 to 5,000 Energon
*For the game's final two events. more resources were made available to buy with Energon: (limit 21 for each Spark)
**T2 Alpha Spark - 80
**Tier 3 Basic Spark - 40
**T3 Alpha Spark - 400
**T4 Basic Spark - 200
**5-Star Bot Crystal - 500
**T4 Bot Crystal - 100
**(seriously none of the highest-end T4 Class and T5 Basics?)

== Obtainment ==
Without paying with real money, Energon can be obtained in various ways:
* Completing Solo and Special Missions; completing a stage will give you 10 Energon, while fully exploring it will give you another 15. (15 and 20 for Prime difficulty respectively)
* Some Solo Mission crates rarely give 5 Energon.
* Arena Crystals have a slight chance of giving a small amount of Energon.
* 10, 20, 30, and 40 Energon can be claimed from the login [[calendar]] on the sixth day of each week.
* 10 bundles of 20 Energon are sometimes available in the Raid Store for 3,000 Raid Chips each, up to 200 Energon for 30,000 Raid Chips.
* From v5.0, three ads can be watched to get <s>5</s> 4 Energon per video each day every 12 hours.
*15 Energon from watching 4 ad videos Daily Objective.
*10 Energon from completing 7 Daily Objectives.

Should you want to bribe your way to victory, several different amounts of Energon are available in the Energon store to purchase with real money.
* Soundwave's Superior Stocks - 135 - $6.99 USD
* Starscream's Embezzled Stores - 275 - $13.99 USD
* Bumblebee's Trunk - 850 - $39.99 USD
* Megatron's Spoils of War - 1450 - $69.99 USD
* King Grimlock's Royal Bounty - 3100 - $129.99 USD
Occasionally, more Energon and additional items are included with these purchases, such as Energon Daily Cards, Crystals, and Bot Chips, before defaulting to Bot Chip bundles.

On October 14, 2022, all ads and in-app purchases were removed, per the announcement of the game shutting down and removal from the App Stores.

From October 2022 onwards, the 7-Day Calendar gave a consecutive 200 to 800 Energon each day, along with 75~750 Premium Bot Crystal Shards.

parsed.lead:
Arena Chips are a currency used to purchase Arena Crystals. They can be earned from Away Missions, and they were awarded in Arenas, but have been replaced with whole Arena Crystals.

Arena Chips originally had more uses; they were described as being able to unlock new arenas, but this mechanic was either dropped or never came to be. They could be donated to an Alliance Treasury for Alliance Missions, but it was later disabled before the Treasury was eventually removed altogether.

As of v6.0, Arena Chips have been completely removed. They were replaced with Arena Crystals in Away Missions.

as_of_2023.raw_wikitext:
[[File:Bot Chip.png|thumb|128x128px|We've run out of bots, so have these so we don't have to worry about making more!]]
'''Bot Chips''' are the primary method of obtaining Featured [[Bot]]s of the month.

== History ==
Bot Chips started out as Raid Event exclusive chips, 1,000 of which could be exchanged for a featured 2-Star Bot. Around 60 chips could be won per raid.

3-Star Featured Bots made their debut with [[Shockwave]], which cost 10,000 Chips and specialized to each Bot.

With the debut of [[Galvatron]], Bot Chips came to the forefront, introducing many more ways to obtain them. 4-Star Featured Bots were also introduced which cost 100,000 Chips. For Galvatron only, remaining chips could be exchanged for Premium Bot Crystal Shards or 4-Star Bot Crystal Shards.

For all featured Bots starting from [[Tantrum]], 5-Star Bots were made available for 1,000,000 Chips.

The debut of [[Cyclonus]] saw a drastic increase in Raid Event and Arena Bot Chips, but the amounts were slightly decreased in raids the following month.

From 2019 onwards, the permanent generic Bot Chips can be used for any 3~5-Star Bot featured in the store.

November 2022 was the very last month to spend Bot Chips on Motormaster, Windblade, Ultra Magnus, and Barricade. You'd think they could buy Bots galore for the finale events but there were '''''absolutely no provisions. And routine Bot Chip Arenas kept running despite nothing to spend them on!'''''

== Costs ==
Each event's bot Bot Chip cost in the store will increase for each duplicate of a Bot bought. There is a 21-amount limit for each tier, enough for a bot with a maxed Signature Ability.

*3-Star - 10,000 + 5,000 per purchase
*4-Star - 100,000 + 40,000 per purchase
*5-Star - 1,000,000 + 300,000 per purchase
(The first 3-Star bot is 10K, the 2nd is 15k, the 3rd is 20k, and so on.)

== Obtainment ==
Listed are current ways to obtain Featured Bot Chips:
* Getting a duplicate 2-Star Bot (100)
* Getting a duplicate 3-Star Bot (1,000)
* Getting a duplicate 4-Star Bot (10,000)
* Getting a duplicate 5-Star Bot (50,000)
* Rare [[Away Mission]]s
* Overlord's Favor [[Arena]]s
* [[Alliance Mission]]s Week 2 and Week 4
* [[Special Mission|Spotlight Mission]] Exploration Rewards
* Login [[Calendar]]
* Monthly [[Objectives]]
*Fourth Week Raids
**1,386 (1500~1,999 Medals)
**1,871 (2,000~2,499 Medals)
**
**2,310 (2,500, max)
* Energon Bundles
* Message from the Game Team (If there are technical difficulties)

== Strategy ==
If you are super casual and only want a 3-Star Bot, you should get more than 25,000 Chips passively.

If you are a level 40+ Commander who plays regularly, and unwilling to drop money and Energon on Crystals' luck, mastering Spotlight Missions, playing a full arena or two, regularly participating in Alliance Missions, raiding daily, and a couple of bot crystals should get you 100,000 chips and then some for a few 3-Stars. <s>Getting 140,000 chips more is a stretch goal that would involve completing almost all the bot arenas.''' '''</s>Now that Raid Events give nearly 2000 chips per raid for a 1500 Medal-range Commander, you only need to raid regularly 6-9 times a day with no need for arenas to get more than enough chips for a duplicate.

== Specialty Chips ==
Even after generic Bot Chips, there were a few events with specialized themed Bot Chips.

=== Autobot Chip ===
[[File:Generations Chips.png|thumb]]
TF-labeled chips for the September 2019 35th anniversary of ''The Transformers'' brand, and Autobot Week.

=== Class Clash Chip ===
[[File:Class Clash Chip.png|thumb|128x128px]]
Chips in June 2019 to introduce a new type of [[Arena]].

''A Clash of Classes is coming! Join us for a Special Week-long event where you can participate in special Arenas and Raids every day to earn class-specific rewards, including 4-Star Class Bot crystals and T4 Class Spark Essence! This event kicks off on June 27th, 2019 at 10am PT and runs until July 4th at 10 am PT!''

* ''Each day, one class will be featured in its own special 24 hour arena. You can only enter that Arena with Bots of the same Class or Bots that have a Class Advantage. For example, on Tech Arena Day, you will be able to use both your Tech and Scout Bots to compete.''
* ''Take on the Class Clash Special Team everyday to earn Extra Points and Class ORE-13! You can also purchase Counter-Class Sparks and ORE-13 in the Store with Class Clash Chips, and Class Premium Bot Crystals for Energon!''
* ''Note: There are Daily Purchase limits on all of these items, and the items in the Store are for the Class that Counter the Class of the Day.''
* ''Class Clash Chips?''
* ''For the duration of the Event, you can earn Class Clash Chips for every successful Raid you complete. Use these Chips in the Store to purchase Class Spark Essence and ORE-13!''
* ''There will also be a 7-Day Raid Ascent event running alongside the Class Clash Event. This event features the regular rewards for Raid Ascent, but also includes a small amount of Class Clash Chips in the rewards!''
* ''Raid Event? That Means Quintesson Bases again…''
* ''We understand that during Raid Events, the amount of Quintesson Bases you run up against might increase quite a bit, but we’ve made some changes!''
* ''During this event, Raid Chips awarded for Quintesson bases will be increased significantly, and they will now award Medals as well! They still won’t match what you get from Raiding another Commander’s base, but will be more comparable.''
* ''Which Bots are in the Crystals?''
* ''We’ve updated the Class Crystals to include all of our regularly available Bots! This means that the only ones not available are Thundercracker, and Bumblebee (Generations), while Bumblebee (DOTM) will be available as a 2 and 3 Star, but not as a 4-Star.''
* ''This is a 7 Day event but there are only 6 classes…''
* ''On July 3, a free-for-all Arena will be available featuring all the class special teams. The top rewards for this event will be 6x 4-Star Class Bot Crystals (1x OF EACH CLASS)!''
* ''This is also your last chance to spend Class Clash Chips on a variety of Class Spark Crystals! This is the only day that the Class Sparks are NOT Class Specific and will be in Crystals!''
* ''What days will each class be featured?''
* ''The arena schedule is:''
** ''• Warrior Clash Arena - June 27''
** ''• Scout Clash Arena - June 28''
** ''• Tech Clash Arena - June 29''
** ''• Demolition Clash Arena - June 30''
** ''• Tactician Clash Arena - July 1''
** ''• Brawler Clash Arena - July 2''
** ''• Free-for-All Clash Arena - July 3''
* ''**** For clarity purpose: Rank up materials are in the Store for Raid Currency (Class Clash Chips) while the Class Shards for Bot Crystals are Arenas.''
*Chips after the event were converted 1:1 gold and then Shards remained for future events.

=== Beast Wars Chip ===
[[File:Beast Wars Chip.png|thumb]]
Chips for a December 2019 Beast Wars event.

''The year is ending and the Beasties are running wild! While timelines and dimensions keep clashing, we take a trip back (or is it forward...and then back again) in time to witness as Dinobot changes from a Predacon to fight with the forces of the Maximals! Will this timeline stay strong, or is it just the start of these Beast Wars?''

* ''This event starts December 19th at 9AM EST and lasts for a total of three weeks!''
* ''As soon as this kicks off you’ll have the chance to get your hands on Beast Wars Chips by completing various activities and can be used to purchase event specific Bots. These bots are changing daily between Predacons and Maximals and will repeat for a total of 3 times before giving everyone the chance at purchasing Crystals with all 6 Bots in them.''
* ''How do we earn these chips? There are several ways!''
* ''[[Proving Fields|PROVING FIELDS]]''
** ''This entire event starts with a 6-Day mission where you must prove your worth with a specific Beast War bot given to play with. You will be challenged to three fights with varying difficulties of your choice. You’re not going to want to miss this! Each day comes with new and unique dialogue.''
* ''CHRONO-VECTORS: [[Rebel Raptor|REBEL RAPTOR]]''
** ''In the second and third week of this event, test your might in our unique story mission centered around Dinobot and his change in loyalty. If you can get through this you will be greatly rewarded with Beast Wars Chips as well as Awakening and Signature Upgrade Programs specific to difficulty chosen. Keep in mind, you’ll only be able to bring a roster of three for this! Choose wisely, Commanders.''
* ''ARENA''
** ''In week two, you will get your chance to earn more Beast Wars chips (alongside the usual rewards) by hitting Milestones in Arenas, earning Rank Rewards, and fighting Special Beast Wars teams.''
* ''OBJECTIVES''
** ''During the event there will be special objectives put into place. By completing all Objectives you’ll be awarded the 4-5 Star Beast Wars Crystal. By completing eight, you’ll receive the 3-4 Star Beast Wars Crystal. Some objectives can reward you 2-4 Star Featured (BW) Bot Crystal. Don’t worry, you’ll get chips alongside these victories!''
** ''• Win Arena Fights using specific Bots.''
** ''• Win Solo Mission Fights using specific Bots.''
** ''• Complete “PROVING FIELDS” missions.''
** ''• Complete “REBEL RAPTOR” missions.''
* ''LOGIN CALENDAR''
** ''There will be a Special 7-Day Calendar weekly to give you login rewards of Beast Wars Chips. Login in daily so to not miss out!''
* ''ENERGON PACKS''
** ''As this event is going on you have the chance to earn Beast War Chips when purchasing Energon Packs!''

=== Faction Chip ===
[[File:Faction Chip.png|thumb|128x128px]]
Some 2022 "sidequest" [[Special Mission|Spotlight Missions]] had '''Faction Chips''' which can be used to buy faction-specific Bots and crystals. They could be carried over between faction events.

There were three events featuring Cinematic bots, Generations Autobots, and Beast Wars. Presumably there would have been a Generations Decepticons event ''if the game didn't shut down.''

How to obtain:

* Objectives
* 7-day Login Calendar
* Faction Chip Arena
* 6-Day Challenge Gauntlet
*Energon bundles

=== Event Store ===

* 3-Star Bot: 800
* 4-Star Bot: 4,000
* 5-Star Bot: 20,000
**The above prices were halved for the final Faction Chip event.
* Faction crystal: 300
*Elite faction crystal: 600
**The Beast Wars event also had them in 5 and 10 bundles directly from the Store page as well as the Crystals page.

sections.heading: Beast Wars Chip
sections.text:
Chips for a December 2019 Beast Wars event.

The year is ending and the Beasties are running wild! While timelines and dimensions keep clashing, we take a trip back (or is it forward...and then back again) in time to witness as Dinobot changes from a Predacon to fight with the forces of the Maximals! Will this timeline stay strong, or is it just the start of these Beast Wars?

* This event starts December 19th at 9AM EST and lasts for a total of three weeks!
* As soon as this kicks off you’ll have the chance to get your hands on Beast Wars Chips by completing various activities and can be used to purchase event specific Bots. These bots are changing daily between Predacons and Maximals and will repeat for a total of 3 times before giving everyone the chance at purchasing Crystals with all 6 Bots in them.
* How do we earn these chips? There are several ways!
* PROVING FIELDS
** This entire event starts with a 6-Day mission where you must prove your worth with a specific Beast War bot given to play with. You will be challenged to three fights with varying difficulties of your choice. You’re not going to want to miss this! Each day comes with new and unique dialogue.
* CHRONO-VECTORS: REBEL RAPTOR
** In the second and third week of this event, test your might in our unique story mission centered around Dinobot and his change in loyalty. If you can get through this you will be greatly rewarded with Beast Wars Chips as well as Awakening and Signature Upgrade Programs specific to difficulty chosen. Keep in mind, you’ll only be able to bring a roster of three for this! Choose wisely, Commanders.
* ARENA
** In week two, you will get your chance to earn more Beast Wars chips (alongside the usual rewards) by hitting Milestones in Arenas, earning Rank Rewards, and fighting Special Beast Wars teams.
* OBJECTIVES
** During the event there will be special objectives put into place. By completing all Objectives you’ll be awarded the 4-5 Star Beast Wars Crystal. By completing eight, you’ll receive the 3-4 Star Beast Wars Crystal. Some objectives can reward you 2-4 Star Featured (BW) Bot Crystal. Don’t worry, you’ll get chips alongside these victories!
** • Win Arena Fights using specific Bots.
** • Win Solo Mission Fights using specific Bots.
** • Complete “PROVING FIELDS” missions.
** • Complete “REBEL RAPTOR” missions.
* LOGIN CALENDAR
** There will be a Special 7-Day Calendar weekly to give you login rewards of Beast Wars Chips. Login in daily so to not miss out!
* ENERGON PACKS
** As this event is going on you have the chance to earn Beast War Chips when purchasing Energon Packs!

sections.heading: Faction Chip
sections.text:
Some 2022 "sidequest" Spotlight Missions had Faction Chips which can be used to buy faction-specific Bots and crystals. They could be carried over between faction events.

There were three events featuring Cinematic bots, Generations Autobots, and Beast Wars. Presumably there would have been a Generations Decepticons event if the game didn't shut down.

How to obtain:

* Objectives
* 7-day Login Calendar
* Faction Chip Arena
* 6-Day Challenge Gauntlet
*Energon bundles

==Obtainment==
Spark Essence is primarily earned through the solo [[Daily Mission]]s. There are two maps for Basic Sparks: An easy map for Tier 1 Basic Spark Essence, and a medium map for Tier 2 Basic Spark Essence. For Class Sparks, there are three maps: an easy map for Tier 1 Class Spark, medium map for around 850 Tier 2 Class Spark Essence, and hard map for around 2100 Tier 2 Class Spark Essence.

Class Spark Essence maps Tiers 1-2 are also rotated throughout the week, with Sunday having all six Tier 1 and Tier 2 Class Spark Essence maps. The order of Class throughout the week is:
*Monday - Crystal Shards
*Tuesday - Brawler
*Wednesday - Warrior
*Thursday - Scout
*Friday - Tech
*Saturday - Demolitions
*Sunday- Tactician

Each day also offers Daily Deals, in-app purchases which are Alpha Spark bundles or Class bundles.

===Tier 1 Basic Sparks===
*Daily Missions
*Alliance Quests
* Free 4-hour Crystal

=== Tier 2 Basic Sparks===
*Crystals
*Raid Store (up to 3 for a total of 30,000 Raid Chips per day)
*Alliance Quests
*Easy and Medium Spotlight Missions

===Tier 3 Basic Sparks===
*Sparks - Can be obtained from Medium, Hard, Expert and Master Special Missions and also from Ancient Santum Crystal 2.0
*Essence - Can be obtained from Hard, Expert and Master Missions, Raids, Rank up Crystal and Alliance Milestones

===Tier 4 Basic Sparks===
*Spark - Completing [[Revenge of the King]]
*Essence - Master Special Missions
**Completion reward: 500 T4 Basic Spark Essence.
**Exploration reward: 2000 T4 Basic Spark Essence
*Alliance Missions Ancient Santum:
**Rank 1-3: 2500 T4 Basic Spark Essence
**Rank 4-6: 1250 T4 Basic Spark Essence
** Rank 7-10: 750 T4 Basic Spark Essence
**Milestones 23-25 rewards 2500 T4 Basic Spark Essence in total

=== Tier 5 Basic Sparks ===

*Selling T4 Basic Sparks (80 essence each)
*Alliance Mission Milestones 27~28 (65,600K~72,170K points)
*Alliance Mission Ranks 1-10
*Prime Difficulty Time-Slide Mission Exploration (2000 essence)

===Tier 1 Alpha Sparks ===
*Alliance Quests
*Spotlight Missions
* up to 5000 Tier 1 Alpha Spark Essence every day in the Raid Store

===Tier 2 Alpha Sparks===
*Alliance Missions and Alliance Quests
*Hard and Expert Spotlight Missions
*Raid Store (total 500 Essence for 28,000 Raid Chips per day)
*Epic Away Missions
Can be earned exactly like T1 Alpha Spark but in much fewer amounts.

===Tier 1 Class Sparks===
*Tier 1 Class Spark Crystal
*Easy Daily Missions

=== Tier 2 Class Sparks===
*Tier 2 Class Spark Crystal
*Tier 2 Essence Crystal
*Medium and Hard Daily Missions

===Tier 3 Class Sparks===

*Selling Tier 2 Class Sparks (40 T3 Essence each)
*Ancient Sanctum Crystals 2.0
*Tier 3 Class Essence Crystal
* Greater Rank Up Crystal
*Tier 3 Class Spark Crystal
*Epic Away Missions
* Completing Monthly Objective by upgrading the featured 4-Star Bot of that month. Earn maximum of 5000 T3 Class Spark Essence of the same class if the featured 4 Star-Bot is upgraded to rank 5
*Leveling Up from level 51. Each level rewards 1000 T3 Class Spark Essence of each Class
* Completing [[Rulers of Kaon]] for a Tier 3 Class Spark Crystal
*Completing [[Revenge of the King]] for 6 T3 Class Sparks for each class.

*Mastering Expert and Master Special Missions, which reward 2 full T3 Class Spark each month. Exploring Expert for 5000 T3 Class Spark Crystal Shards and exploring Master for a whole T3 Class Spark and 5000 T3 Class Spark Crystal Shards

=== Tier 4 Class Sparks===

* Selling T3 Class Sparks
* [[Fog of War]] Missions
* Tier 3 Ore-13 Crystals
* Bot Battle [[Alliance Quest]]: T4 Essence Crystal, 1,000 T4 Class Spark Crystal shards
* Prime Special Mission exploration (1,000 shards)

===Tier 1 Mod Sparks ===
*Base Bounty Arenas
*Tier 1 Mod Class Spark Crystal

===Tier 2 Mod Sparks ===
*in-app purchases or special Energon offers
*Tier 2 Mod Class Spark Crystals, i.e. from completing Master Spotlight Missions

===Tier 2 Mod Sparks===

*The items's description says obtained from Alliance Missions, but has never materialized.

==Rank Recipes==
Listed are the Sparks and Gold needed to Rank Up Bots and Mods according to star rating. The higher the star rating, the more Sparks that are harder to obtain are required.

===Bots===
*'''1-Star Rank 2: '''1 T1 Basic Spark, 2,000 Gold
*'''2-Star Rank 2: '''2 T1 Basic Spark, 5,000 Gold
*'''2-Star Rank 3: '''3 T1 Basic Spark, 1 T1 Class Spark, 9,000 Gold
*'''3-Star Rank 2: '''1 T2 Basic Spark, 2 T1 Class Spark, 12,500 Gold
*'''3-Star Rank 3: '''2 T2 Basic Spark, 1 T2 Class Spark, 22,500 Gold
*'''3-Star Rank 4: '''3 T2 Basic Spark, 2 T2 Class Spark, 1 T1 Alpha Spark, 40,500 Gold
*'''4-Star Rank 2: '''4 T2 Basic Spark, 3 T2 Class Spark, 2 T1 Alpha Spark, 31,250 Gold
*'''4-Star Rank 3: '''1 T3 Basic Spark. 4 T2 Class Spark, 3 T1 Alpha Spark, 56,250 Gold
*'''4-Star Rank 4: '''2 T3 Basic Spark, 5 T2 Class Spark, 1 T2 Alpha Spark, 101,250 Gold
*'''4-Star Rank 5: '''3 T3 Basic Spark, 1 T3 Class Spark, 2 T2 Alpha Spark, 182,250 Gold
*'''5-Star Rank 2:''' 4 T3 Basic Spark, 2 T3 Class Spark, 3 T2 Alpha Spark, 109,375 Gold
*'''5-Star Rank 3:''' 1 T4 Basic Spark, 3 T3 Class Spark, 4 T2 Alpha Spark, 196,875 Gold
*'''5-Star Rank 4:''' 2 T4 Basic Spark, 4 T3 Class Spark, 1 T3 Alpha Spark, 354,375 Gold
*'''5-Star Rank 5:''' 3 T4 Basic Spark, 1 T4 Class Spark, 2 T3 Alpha Spark, 637,875 Gold
*'''5-Star Rank 6:''' 1 T5 Basic Spark, 2 T4 Class Spark, 3 T3 Alpha Spark, 1,148,875 Gold

=== Mods===
*'''1-Star Rank 2: '''1 T1 Basic Spark, 500 Gold
*'''2-Star Rank 2: '''1 T1 Basic Spark, 1157 Gold
*'''2-Star Rank 3: '''2 T1 Basic Spark, 1799 Gold
*'''3-Star Rank 2: '''3 T1 Basic Spark, 2976 Gold
*'''3-Star Rank 3: '''1 T2 Basic Spark, 1 T1 Mod Class Spark, 6672 Gold
*'''3-Star Rank 4: '''2 T2 Basic Spark, 2 T1 Mod Class Spark, 15,078 Gold
*'''4-Star Rank 2:''' 3 T2 Basic Spark, 3 T1 Mod Spark, 15998 Gold
*'''4-Star Rank 3:''' 1 T3 Basic Spark, 1 T2 Mod Class Spark, 1 T1 Alpha Spark, 32,545 Gold
*'''4-Star Rank 4:''' 2 T3 Basic Spark, 1 T3 Mod Class Spark, 2 T1 Alpha Spark, 63291 Gold
*'''4-Star Rank 5:''' 3 T3 Basic Spark, 1 T4 Mod Class Spark, 3 T1 Alpha Spark (speculated), Unknown price, probably around 127000 gold

Overall, the total sparks that are required to max rank a bot is as follows:
*'''1-Star Bot:''' 1 T1 Basic Spark
*'''2-Star Bot:''' 5 T1 Basic Spark, 1 T1 Class Spark
*'''3-Star Bot:''' 6 T2 Basic Spark, 2 T1 Class Spark, 3 T2 Class Spark, 1 T1 Alpha Spark
*'''4-Star Bot:''' 4 T2 Basic Spark, 6 T3 Basic Spark, 12 T2 Class Spark, 1 T3 Class Spark, 5 T1 Alpha Spark, 3 T2 Alpha Spark
*'''5-Star Bot:''' 4 T3 Basic Spark, 6 T4 Basic Spark, 9 T3 Class Spark, 1 T4 Class Spark, 7 T2 Alpha Spark, 3 T3 Alpha Spark
[[File:23376356 189518801609868 6058695352862655587 n.jpg|thumb|273x273px|List containing rank up requirements, from 411 Infobot]]

==Trivia==
The difficulty of obtaining a Spark increases in this following order: Basic -> Class -> Alpha -> Mod. More specifically, this list of difficulty is as follows:
*T1 Basic -> T1 Class -> T2 Basic -> T2 Class -> T1 Alpha -> T1 Mod -> T3 Basic -> T2 Alpha -> T3 Class -> T4 Basic -> T2 Mod

*The shapes of Sparks are polyhedrons:
**A T1 Spark's shape is a Platonic (Regular) Tetrahedron
**A T2 Spark's shape is a Platonic (Regular) Octahedron
**A T3 Spark's shape is a Archimedean Cuboctahedron
**A T4 Spark's shape is a Platonic (Regular) Dodecahedron
**A T5 Spark's shape is a Icosahedron

Basic and Class Spark have silver borders, while Alpha and Mod Spark have black borders.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
The difficulty of obtaining a Spark increases in this following order: Basic -> Class -> Alpha -> Mod. More specifically, this list of difficulty is as follows:
*T1 Basic -> T1 Class -> T2 Basic -> T2 Class -> T1 Alpha -> T1 Mod -> T3 Basic -> T2 Alpha -> T3 Class -> T4 Basic -> T2 Mod

*The shapes of Sparks are polyhedrons:
**A T1 Spark's shape is a Platonic (Regular) Tetrahedron
**A T2 Spark's shape is a Platonic (Regular) Octahedron
**A T3 Spark's shape is a Archimedean Cuboctahedron
**A T4 Spark's shape is a Platonic (Regular) Dodecahedron
**A T5 Spark's shape is a Icosahedron

Basic and Class Spark have silver borders, while Alpha and Mod Spark have black borders.
